scope: SDK event queue optimization only; rquickjs/core-engine comparisons are unchanged.

behavior.change: Serialize once per validated event and retain its enqueue-time byte count in a shared immutable queue entry. Dequeue subtracts that count. Clearing stopped queues resets bytes.
behavior.payloadSemantics: Listeners still share the validated mutable payload; no cloning, freezing or subscriber isolation API change. Queue byte accounting measures serialized payload size at enqueue time.
behavior.regressions: Four mutation regressions fail against the saved baseline and pass on the final SDK: harness and actual child-process tests for cycle mutation and premature OVERLOADED after a prior subscriber shrinks payloads. Four additional cases cover bounded queue count/bytes, blocked callbacks and listener/onError failure isolation.

snapshotInstructions: Before editing, compile the current SDK to a new snapshot directory: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/plugin-sdk/tsconfig.json --outDir <snapshot> --declaration false. Retain the SDK source as <snapshot>/index.ts and a package.json containing {"type":"module"}.

Write <snapshot>/build.json with source.sha256 and emitted.sha256 for index.ts/index.js, the exact command, Node/TypeScript version, Git state and source/config/dependency fingerprints. The builds embedded below show the retained format and exact commands.

After editing, repeat compilation/capture into another new directory. Keep the same emitted plugin-protocol package and lockfile; both snapshots must resolve it. The run command verifies hashes before and after timing and refuses a pre-existing output file.

Run Node 22.14+ tools/plugins/benchmark-event-queue.mjs --before <before>/index.js --after <after>/index.js --samples 21 --events 64 --output <new report>. Repeat in three new Node processes on a quiet host; phase order alternates within each process.
